_source: Pre-first-run fallback only: the pipeline measures this per chamber every run (score_calculator.compute_constituent_reference — per-party least squares of break rate on seat alignment, kinked at a swing seat) and writes /data/constituent_reference.json, which takes precedence. These values are the hand-set curve Constituent Alignment used before v6.13 (expected break rate 3% in a safe aligned seat, 8% in a swing seat, 20% in a strongly opposed one; saturation 25 points), rewritten in the fitted form (a + b*alignment + b_opposed*min(alignment, 0)) and applied to both parties; no measurement of the live population exists yet to replace them. The first pipeline run does. Regenerate from a populated database with backend/scripts/calibrate_constituent_reference.py.
